name: frill
label: Frill
description: Collect feedback, manage ideas, and publish announcements with Frill.

token.label: API Key
token.description:
To get your Frill API key:
1. Log in to your Frill dashboard at https://app.frill.co
2. Go to **Settings > API**
3. Click **Create API Key**
4. Copy the key and paste it here

The key is used in the Authorization header as a Bearer token.

create_comment.label: Create Comment
create_comment.description: Add a public comment or internal note to an existing idea.

idea.label: Idea
idea.description: Select the feedback or idea to work with

message.label: Message
message.description: The comment text in Markdown format.

is_private.label: Internal Note
is_private.description: Check to post this as a private internal note instead of a public comment.

create_announcement.label: Create Announcement
create_announcement.description: Publish a changelog or product update announcement.

content.label: Content
content.description: The announcement body in Markdown format.

is_published.label: Publish Immediately
is_published.description: Check to publish immediately. Uncheck to save as draft.

create_follower.label: Create Follower
create_follower.description: Add a new user (follower) to Frill, optionally with custom attributes and company data.

attributes.label: Custom Attributes
attributes.description: Optional custom attributes as key-value pairs (requires custom attributes feature).

companies.label: Companies
companies.description: Companies to associate with this follower. Find company IDs in your Frill dashboard under Settings > Companies.

update_follower.label: Update Follower
update_follower.description: Update an existing user (follower), including custom attributes and company associations.

name.label: Name
name.description: New name for the follower. Leave empty to keep unchanged.

email.label: Email
email.description: New email address. Leave empty to keep unchanged.

attributes.label: Custom Attributes
attributes.description: Custom attributes to merge with existing ones (requires custom attributes feature).

companies.label: Companies
companies.description: Companies to merge with this follower's existing associations. Find company IDs in your Frill dashboard under Settings > Companies.

get_ideas.label: Get Ideas
get_ideas.description: Fetch a list of ideas/feedback entries from Frill.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of ideas to return. Defaults to 20.

status.label: Status
status.description: Select the status for the idea

get_comments.label: Get Comments
get_comments.description: Fetch comments for a specific idea or all recent comments.

idea.label: Idea
idea.description: Optionally filter comments by a specific idea

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of comments to return. Defaults to 20.
